name: data-model.md
html:
Firebase data model

Root: translations/<locale>/ for each of the 16 locales. database.json in the repo is the source-of-truth snapshot baked into the bundle and synced to Firebase.

flowchart TB TR["translations/<loc>/"] TR --> APP["APP/ — global UI strings"] APP --- COMP["components/ — component copy:<br/>contact: {title, line1, line2}<br/>legal-footer: {links: [{link, page}]}<br/>related: {title, note, path, projects,<br/>socials: [{link, network}]}<br/>preferences-modal, lang-dialog,<br/>media, source-code, …"] COMP --- PAGES["pages/ — route copy:<br/>HOME, ABOUT, GDPR, PRIVACY,<br/>TERMS, NOT_FOUND, EARTH_PLAYGROUND"] PAGES --- PROJ["projects/ — case studies:<br/><key>: {cover{src,isVideo}, folder,<br/>sections: [[texts, media], …]}"] PROJ --- SLUGS["slugs/ — localized route slugs"]

Node contracts

APP

Flat-ish dict of global strings. Required subtrees: about, actions, contact, cookies, related, scrollup, title, preferences, language, pref, carousel, statsHud (fps,cpu,gpu,net,lat,requests,mem, engine{on,off,description}), earthPlayground, menu, close, loader, engine, media, awards, sitePreferences, loading, notFound.

components/related (case-study footer)

{
  "title": "Related projects",
  "note": "…disclaimer paragraph…",
  "path": "…",
  "projects": ["slug-a", "slug-b"],
  "socials": [{ "link": "https://…", "network": "GitHub" }]
}

CMS maps note ↔ "disclaimer". Writes must merge path/projects back.

components/legal-footer

{
  "links": [
    { "link": "/", "page": "Home" },
    { "link": "/privacy-policy", "page": "Privacy Policy" },
    { "link": "/gdpr", "page": "GDPR" },
    { "link": "/terms-of-use", "page": "Terms of Use" }
  ]
}

The label field is page, not label/description.

projects/<key>

sections is an array of [texts, media] tuples:

"sections": [
  [ { "title": "…", "text": "…" },
    [ { "src": "img-name", "isVideo": false, "size": [1920,1080], "label": "…" } ] ]
]

Media filenames carry no extension; consumers append the CDN suffixes (-mozjpg3-MSSIM-tuned-kodak.jpg, .mp4, .mp4.jpg-thumb.jpg, …).

slugs

{
  "HOME": "home",
  "PROJECT": "portfolio",
  "PRIVACY": "privacy-policy",
  "GDPR": "gdpr",
  "TERMS": "terms-of-use",
  "EARTH_PLAYGROUND": "earth-playground"
}

Missing keys fall back to LANG_SLUGS defaults at merge time.

pages/EARTH_PLAYGROUND

39 label keys — the complete panel vocabulary (camera, earth, terrain, postFx, bloom, vignette, chromaticAb, filmGrain, color, debug, screenshot, copyConstants, position, target …).

Sync workflow

  1. Edit database.json (or via CMS for content edits).
  2. yarn build — Vite plugin emits per-locale snapshot chunks.
  3. Push to Firebase: firebase database:set /translations database-extract.json (verified repo-is-newer before overwriting; live has no keys absent from the snapshot).
  4. SWR contract: live null never wipes snapshot content; equality is order-insensitive.
